verdict.rationale: A live probe shows ReadMe's own ReadMe-hosted docs serving /llms.txt (HTTP 200), with section-level llms.txt URLs and per-page .md variants. ReadMe also documents an AI Discoverability feature for making docs accessible to agents. However, nothing explicitly documents that every customer hub serves llms.txt automatically, and no full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs that customer hubs auto-generate llms.txt, evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my published docs site automatically serves llms.txt (and a full-content variant) so agents can index it

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to
Make your documentation discoverable and accessible to AI agents and the assistant
ReadMe crawls a sample of your published pages and scores your project against the Agent-Friendly Docs spec
